Hi Lisa —

Thanks for the heads up and the timeline. We can accommodate your request, and the usual process we follow is: 
1) Execute an NDA (we accept countersigned Oakmont NDAs; I can also provide our standard mutual NDA).
2) Once NDA is in place we provide: a redacted PDF excerpt of the SOC 2 Type II report and a short attestation letter from our security team summarizing the audit period and any relevant control changes.
3) We will provision a secure, time-limited link for download and (if helpful) schedule a brief walkthrough with our security lead.

Proposed next steps: 
- If you send your NDA we will route to legal (cc'd Marissa) for countersignature.
- Target turnaround after countersigned NDA: 48 business hours to provision the redacted excerpt + attestation.

I attached a draft Oakmont_eNDA_v1.docx (suggested minimal edits) for legal to review. If you prefer to send your form, please attach and we'll review.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
